language.title: Language
language.matchDeviceHint: Follows your phone, where Elixir Books Smart has the language.
language.note: Tax terms like GST, GSTIN and HSN stay in English, because that is how they appear on your filings.

company.name: Business name
company.countryFixed: Country and base currency are fixed once a business has transactions.
company.compositionHint: Invoices are raised without a tax breakdown.
company.logoHint: Your business logo. PNG or JPEG, up to 5 MB.
company.logoQueued: Logo saved. It will upload as soon as you're online.
company.logoOffline: You're offline. Connect to the internet to change your logo.
company.logoFailed: The logo you added couldn't be uploaded: {{reason}} Please add it again.
company.logoTooLarge: That image is over 5 MB. Choose a smaller one.
company.logoBadType: Use a PNG or JPEG image.
company.lockedNotice: Entries have been posted, so the legal name, state, financial year and GST registration are locked. An unregistered business can still register for GST.
company.lutHint: With a valid Letter of Undertaking, export invoices are zero-rated: no IGST is charged.
company.allowNegativeStockHint: Let invoices and deliveries sell more than the branch has in stock. When off, they cannot be finalised until the stock is added.

accounts.name: Account name
accounts.openingBalanceDateHint: The day this balance was counted. It can’t be a future date.
accounts.useDefaultHint: Pre-selected when recording payments and expenses.
accounts.deleteMessage: Payments already recorded against it keep their reference. This cannot be undone.
accounts.cashCaption: Opening balances plus everything recorded since
accounts.inUse: This account has payments or expenses, so its type can’t change and it can’t be deleted.

branches.name: Branch name
branches.primaryHint: Used as the default on new documents.
branches.deleteMessage: Documents already recorded against this branch keep their reference. This cannot be undone.
branches.gstinHint: Leave blank if this branch uses the company GSTIN.
branches.gstinStateMismatch: This GSTIN is registered in {{state}}, not the state below
branches.codeTaken: Another branch already uses the code {{code}}. Pick a different code.
branches.intro: Branches let you keep stock and documents separate by location. Every document records which branch it belongs to, and reports can be filtered by it.
branches.addressTaken: Another branch ({{name}}) is already at this address.

taxes.name: Name
taxes.effectiveHint: Documents dated before this keep their original rate.
taxes.deleteMessage: Existing documents keep the rate they were issued with. Items using it will need a new rate.
taxes.introGst: Each rate splits into CGST + SGST within your state, or a single IGST line for inter-state supplies. Rates carry an effective date so past documents keep the treatment they were issued under.
taxes.intro: Rates carry an effective date so past documents keep the treatment they were issued under.

applied.roundingValue: Half-up to the paisa, then the document total to the rupee

about.illustrations: Free illustrations, used under the Storyset licence
about.pitch: Everyday business management from a phone — invoices, payments, purchases and stock, without ERP complexity.
about.note: Your books live on the server. This device keeps a working copy, so you can carry on offline; changes are queued and sent when you are back online, and the server validates every finalised record before it counts.

backup.jsonHint: Full records, ready to import elsewhere
backup.csvHint: Every table as a CSV file, zipped together
backup.exportMessage: The package contains customer details and financial records. Share it only with people who should see them.
backup.scopeNote_one: The export covers this business only. Your other business stays out of the package, so you can hand an auditor exactly one set of books.
backup.scopeNote_other: The export covers this business only. Your other businesses stay out of the package, so you can hand an auditor exactly one set of books.
backup.retentionNote: Financial records subject to statutory retention are kept even if you remove them from this device.

currencies.noneBody: Add a rate to invoice in another currency.
currencies.effectiveHint: Documents dated on or after this use the new rate.
currencies.baseNote: Every report is presented in this currency. Documents raised in another currency store the rate that applied on their date, so historical totals never shift.

sync.noneBody: Every change has reached the server.
sync.conflictNote: Conflicts are surfaced for you to resolve rather than being overwritten silently.
sync.offlineNow: Offline. Changes are saved on this device and sent when you're back online.
sync.conflictBody: Someone saved this after you started editing. You now see their version. Send yours again to replace it, or discard it.
sync.discardAllMessage: They are removed from this device and never reach the server. Anything you added or edited offline goes back to what the server has.
sync.stillWaiting_one: {{count}} change is still waiting to sync
sync.stillWaiting_other: {{count}} changes are still waiting to sync
sync.reloaded: Up to date with the server
sync.offlineBody: You can keep drafting. Anything you create is queued and sent as soon as you are back online.
sync.onlineBody: Finalised financial records are validated on the server before they count, so your books stay authoritative.

transporters.noneBody: Add the carriers you use, so Part-B is a pick rather than a retype.
transporters.name: Name
transporters.idHint: A GSTIN, or a TRANSIN if the carrier is not registered.
transporters.idInvalid: Transporter ID must be a valid 15-character GSTIN or TRANSIN
transporters.idTaken: Another transporter already has this ID
transporters.deleteMessage: E-way bills already raised keep it; it just won't be offered for new ones.
transporters.dialogBody: Carriers you pick from when you fill in Part-B of an e-way bill.

numbering.branchHint: Useful when several locations issue documents.
numbering.tooLongForEInvoice: Longer than {{count}} characters — the e-invoice portal will reject this number.
numbering.intro: Each document type has its own series. A number is assigned only when a document is finalised, and a finalised number is never reused — drafts stay unnumbered so you can delete them freely.

users.name: Name
users.removeMessage: They immediately lose access to this business. Documents they created stay in your books.
users.limitMessage_one: Your {{plan}} plan includes {{count}} user, and that seat is taken (a pending invitation counts). Upgrade to invite more people.
users.limitMessage_other: Your {{plan}} plan includes {{count}} users, and every seat is taken (pending invitations count). Upgrade to invite more people.

roleHint.owner: Full access, including billing and deleting the business.
roleHint.admin: Everything except billing and deleting the business.
roleHint.accountant: Invoices, bills, payments, expenses and reports.
roleHint.sales: Quotes, invoices, customers and payments received.
roleHint.viewer: Read-only access to documents and reports.

users.guestNote: This person has their own Elixir Books account. To change their access, remove them and invite them again.

devices.signOutMessage: That device will need to sign in again to reach your books.
devices.revokeNote: Signing a device out revokes its session immediately — it cannot keep using the app with a cached token.
devices.keychainNote: Session tokens are held in the platform keychain, never in plain storage.

audit.noneBody: Actions you take are logged here.
audit.note: Audit records cannot be edited or deleted from the app. Export them with your company backup for your records.

categories.name: Category name
categories.deleteMessage: Expenses already in this category keep their reference but will show as uncategorised.

appearance.tipsReset: Gesture tips will show again above the tab bar
appearance.statusColourNote: Status colours stay reserved for state, so they never double as chart series colours.

way.holdTabHint: Press and hold any tab; Lixi opens already answering about it.
way.swipeUp: Swipe up on the tab bar
way.swipeUpHint: Pull up from the bar and let go once the orb locks in.
way.floatingOrbHint: A small orb on the screen edge. Drag it anywhere; tap to open.
way.pullDownHint: Pull the Home screen down, like refreshing, to ask Lixi.

appearance.allOffNote: With every way off, Lixi is still under {{more}} → {{askLixi}}.

mode.systemHint: Follows your phone’s light or dark setting.
mode.darkHint: The default look, easy on the eyes indoors.

group.paymentsHint: Let customers pay an invoice without leaving it.
group.messagingHint: How invoices and reminders reach your customers.
group.accountingHint: Hand data to your accountant in their format.
group.storageHint: Where copies of your documents are kept.

integrations.intro: Each provider sits behind an adapter, so swapping one out never changes how your documents work. Turning one on saves the choice for this business; providers that need an account ask you to connect it.
